resolutions.note: The Quittung and Stettler's private possession of it were cut entirely (Change 1, 3, 4); the copied note now says the original went to the Bezirksamt with Rieder's own report.
The sentence describing the hand trembling while copying out the confession alone was cut outright (Change 1).
'geriet ihm trotzdem zu einem kleinen Blitz' was changed to 'geriet ihm gerade', showing the hand steady instead of shaking (Change 1).
A beat was added stating the Krankenblatt was not found among Kalt's estate and will not be found (Change 3).
The closing reflection now states no witness and no written page survives except what Stettler himself wrote (Change 5).
